Name: Cats of Final Fantasy - Tora Jiro
Author: chlpper
Description:
After a years hiatus, the second Cats of Final Fantasy mod is out! Starring Tora Jiro!

I'm hoping to churn out mods of other cats and minions more regularly though, I can't say if I'll hold my word against myself x)

I hope you enjoy this mod!

Join my Discord to follow my mod updates: [url=https://discord.gg/jkgbQStGX8]https://discord.gg/jkgbQStGX8[/url]
